title: Synthesis, in vitro evaluation and computational modelling of benzene sulfonamide derivatives as Dickkopf 1 inhibitors for anticancer drug development.
authors: Bilal, Muhammad Sajjad; Ejaz, Syeda Abida; Naseem, Sadia; Channar, Pervaiz Ali; Saeed, Aamer; Zargar, Seema; Ujan, Rabail; Sahito, Reshma; Abbas, Qamar; Wani, Tanveer A
one_liner_zh: 该研究合成苯磺酰胺衍生物并评估其对CA-II和Dkk1的抑制活性，含分子对接和DNA结合实验，但核心是药物小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且DNA结合仅为辅助验证，方法上无AI或物理模拟创新，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: In the modern age of drug discovery sulfanilamide derivatives are known to have great anti-cancerous potential, the current study aimed to synthesize these derivatives in order to evaluate their biological properties against carbonic anhydrase II (CA-II) and Dickkopf - 1(Dkk1) protein which are highly expressed in many cancers including lung cancer. A series of 10 sulfanilamide derivatives was synthesized under controlled conditions using reflux condensation method. Among all the synthesized derivatives (5a-5j), the compound 5d was found to possess highest antioxidant activity (90.7397 +/- 0.0732 microg/mL) comparable to vitamin C (95.1571 +/- 0.057 microg/mL) and also exhibited maximum inhibition against CA-II with an IC(50) value of 0.00690 +/- 0.1119 microM, indicating that 5d is significantly more potent as compared to standard i.e., acetazolamide IC(50) = 0.9979 +/- 0.0024 microM. Keeping in view the importance of Dkk1 protein in cancer progression, the molecular docking investigations were performed, where compound 5d was proved to be the potential dual inhibitor of CA-II as well as Dkk1 with the binding energy of 8.9 and 9.7 kcal/mol, respectively. In addition to this DNA binding studies also confirmed the significance of compound 5d where it had maximum binding constant value of 6.7 x 10(4) mol(- 1), supporting the other biological investigations and was in agreement with the reported values. All the experimental and computational results reveals the excellent potential of 5d as a candidate medicine in future. Conclusively, the current study may lead to the new therapeutic strategies for the treatment of cancer associated with the aberrant expression of CA-II and less explored DDK1 target.
abstract_zh: 在现代药物发现领域，磺胺衍生物已知具有巨大的抗癌潜力，本研究旨在合成这些衍生物，以评估其对碳酸酐酶II（CA-II）和Dickkopf-1（Dkk1）蛋白的生物活性，这些蛋白在包括肺癌在内的多种癌症中高表达。采用回流冷凝法在受控条件下合成了一系列共10种磺胺衍生物。在所有合成的衍生物（5a-5j）中，化合物5d被发现具有最高的抗氧化活性（90.7397 ± 0.0732微克/毫升），与维生素C（95.1571 ± 0.057微克/毫升）相当，并且对CA-II表现出最大抑制作用，其IC(50)值为0.00690 ± 0.1119微摩尔，表明5d显著优于标准药物乙酰唑胺（IC(50) = 0.9979 ± 0.0024微摩尔）。鉴于Dkk1蛋白在癌症进展中的重要性，进行了分子对接研究，其中化合物5d被证明是CA-II和Dkk1的潜在双重抑制剂，其结合能分别为8.9和9.7千卡/摩尔。此外，DNA结合研究也证实了化合物5d的重要性，其最大结合常数值为6.7 × 10(4)摩尔(-1)，支持了其他生物学研究，并与已报道值一致。所有实验和计算结果揭示了5d作为未来候选药物的巨大潜力。总之，本研究可能为与CA-II异常表达及较少探索的DDK1靶点相关的癌症治疗提供新的治疗策略。
